s.n: Mr Wu's pork and prawn dumplings
s.note: Steamed pork, prawn and ginger dumplings
s.how: Mix 250g pork mince with 150g chopped green prawns, grated ginger and a splash of soy. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Steam in a lined bamboo basket for 8 minutes. Serve hot with soy sauce and chilli oil for dipping.

s.n: Agent K's shrimp and bok choy
s.note: Green prawns and baby bok choy wok-tossed with garlic, ginger and oyster sauce
s.how: Peel and devein 250g green prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 1 tsp cornflour. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok until smoking and fry the prawns for 2 minutes until just pink, then lift out. Add 2 sliced garlic cloves and a little ginger in matchsticks and fry for 30 seconds. Add 2 halved baby bok choy and a splash of water and toss for 2 minutes. Return the prawns with 1 tbsp oyster sauce and a splash of soy, toss and serve.

m.note: Steamed snapper with ginger, spring onion and sizzling soy
m.how: Cook 300g jasmine rice. Lay 4 skin-on snapper fillets on a heatproof plate over a thumb of ginger in matchsticks and steam over simmering water for 8 to 10 minutes until just flaking. Scatter with 4 shredded spring onions. Heat 3 tbsp vegetable oil until smoking and pour over the fish, then spoon over 3 tbsp light soy mixed with 1 tsp sugar and 2 tbsp of the steaming water. Serve with the rice.

w.note: Cinnamon green apples under a lattice crust
w.how: Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice on top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes and serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

d.note: Vodka, coffee liqueur and strong espresso shaken ice cold
d.how: Chill 4 martini glasses in the freezer. Make 4 shots of strong espresso or 200ml very strong coffee and cool for 5 minutes. Shake 2 drinks at a time: 90ml vodka, 60ml coffee liqueur, 100ml espresso and 1 tbsp sugar syrup with a big scoop of ice, shaking hard for 20 seconds. Strain into the glasses and float 3 coffee beans on the foam. For non-drinkers, shake espresso with syrup and milk over ice.
